content: Mahwen Sarawi ong mehn Midian
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Dupukohng mehn Midian kan dahme re wiahiong mehn Israel kan. Mwurin omw pahn kapwaiada met, ke ahpw pahn mehla.”
Moses eri patohwanohng aramas ako, “Kumwail onopada, pwe kumwail en mahweniong mehn Midian kan oh kaloke irail pwehki ar kauwehla kupwuren KAUN-O.
Kumwail pahn pilada ohl kid sang ni ehuehu kadaudok en mehn Israel kan pwe re en onopada ong mahwen.”
Ohl kid eri pilipilda sang ehuehu kadaudok en mehn Israel ko, koaros patpene me nen riekid me onopada ong mahwen.
Moses eri kadar irail pahn kaweidpen Pineas, nein samworo Eleasar, me kolokol dipwisou sarawi ko iangahki sowi ko mehn wia pakair.
Re ahpw tapihada mahweniong mehn Midian duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanihong Moses, oh re kemehla ohl koaros,
iangahki nanmwarki limmen en Midian: Epi, Rekem, Sur, Hur, oh Repa. Re pil kemehla Palaam, nain Peor.
Mehn Israel ko eri salihedi lih en Midian ko oh nair seri ko iangahki neirail pelinmen ko, oh kihsang ar dipwisou kan koaros.
Re pil isikala ar kahnimw kan oh imwarail impwal kan.
Re ahpw ale dipwisou lohdi koaros, iangahki aramas selidi koaros oh pelinmen kan,
oh wahla rehn Moses oh Eleasar oh rehn mehn Israel ko me mihmi ni imwarail impwal ko nan patapat en Mohap ni keilen Pillap Sordan sallahng Seriko.
Sapahldohn Karis kan
Moses, Eleasar oh kaunen mehn Israel koaros ahpw kohieilasang nan ar kahnimpwalo pwe re en kasamwo karis en sounpei ko.
Moses eri lingeringerda pahn kaunen sounpei ko, irail kan me kaweid pwihn kan me sapahldohsang nan mahwen.
E ahpw idekda rehrail, “Ia kahrepen amwail sohte kemehla lih akan?

Kumwail tamataman pwe iei irail me idawehnla kaweid en Palaam oh kahrehiong mehn Israel kan ar soaloalopwoat ong KAUN-O nan Peor. Ih kahrepen soumwahu lusulus me KAUN-O ketikidohng pohn mehn Israel ko.
Eri met kumwail kemehla pwutak koaros oh lih koaros me wiahier nsenen pwopwoud.
Ahpw kumwail kak kolokol ong pein kumwail serepein kan oh lih meipwon kan.

Eri met kumwail koaros me kemelahr aramas emen de doahkehda aramas mehla men pahn mihmi likin kahnimpwalo erein rahn isuh. Ni kesiluhn rahn oh ni keisuhn rahn kumwail pahn kamwakeleikumwailda iangahki lih akan me kumwail salihedi.
Kumwail pahn pil kamwakelehda likou koaros oh mehkoaros me wiawihda sang kilin kou, kilin kuht de tuhke.”
Eleasar eri patohwanohng sounpei ko me ahpwtehn pwurodo sang mahwen, “Ih met koasoandi me KAUN-O ketikihong Moses.
Mehkoaros me sohte kin mwasikala, rasehng kohl, silper, prons, mete, dihn oh leht pahn kohieng nan kisiniei pwehn mwakelekella. Soahng teikan koaros pahn kin kamwakelkihda pilen kamwakel.
Ni keisuhn rahn kumwail pahn lopworada amwail likou kan; kumwail ahpw pahn mwakelekella ong kaudok, oh pwurehng pedolong nan kahnimpwalo.”
Nehnehn Dipwisou Lohdi ko
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Kowe oh Eleasar iangahki kaun teikan en mehn Israel, pahn wadekedi mehkoaros me lohdi nan mahwen, iangahki aramas selidi kan oh pelinmen kan.
Kumwail ahpw pahn nehkpeseng ni pahrek, apali pahn kohieng sounpei kan, a apali pahn kohieng mehn Israel teikan.
Daksis pahn kohieng KAUN-O, sang pali me pahn kohieng sounpei kan, eri emen aramas sang nan wad en aramas selidi limepwiki, pil duwehte sang rehn mahn akan, kou, ahs, sihpw, oh kuht kan.
Patohwanohng samworo Eleasar nin duwen meirong kesempwal ehu ong KAUN-O.

Sang ni pali me pahn kohieng mehn Israel kan, ale emen aramas sang nan wad en aramas selidi limehk, pil duwehte sang rehn mahn akan, kou, ahs, sihpw, oh kuht kan. Mepwukat pahn kohieng mehn Lipai kan me kin apwahpwalih Impwalen KAUN-O.”
Moses oh Eleasar eri kapwaiada dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsanih.
Iet uwen tohtohn mehkoaros me sounpei kan kalowehdi nan mahwen, likin me emenemen koledi ong pein ih: sihpw oh kuht me 675,000, kou 72,000, ahs 61,000, serepein meipwon 32,000.

Apali me kohieng sounpei ko, sihpw oh kuht 337,500. Sang mepwukat daksis ong KAUN-O me 675: ong sounpei ko kou 36,000, daksis ong KAUN-O 72. Ong sounpei ko ahs 30,500, daksis ong KAUN-O 61. Serepein meipwon ong sounpei ko 16,000, daksis ong KAUN-O 32.
Moses eri kihong Eleasar daksis ko mehn wia meirong kesempwal ehu ong KAUN-O, nin duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih.
Uwen me kohieng mehn Israel ko pil duwehte me kohieng sounpei ko: sihpw oh kuht 337,500, kou 36,000, ahs 30,500 oh serepein meipwon 16,000.

Sang ni pali wet Moses alehsang emen aramas sang ni wad en aramas selidi limehk, pil duwehte ong mahn akan, duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih, e ahpw patohwanohng mehn Lipai ko me kin apwahpwalih Impwalen KAUN-O.
Kaunen pwihn en sounpei kan eri patohla rehn Moses
oh patohwanohng, “Maing, se patohwan wadekehr sounpei ko me emenemen kiht kaunda, oh sohte me salongala.
Eri se patohwandohr kapwat kohl pwukat, luwou, rihng, mehn tiati, oh mwaramwar kan me emenemen kiht aledier. Se patohwan mweidohng KAUN-O pwehn wia at tungoal meirong oh en ketin sinsilei kiht.”
Moses oh Eleasar ahpw ale kohl me mihmi ni kapwat kan.
Toutou en kapwat pwukat koaros me sounpei ko kihda mihmi pohnangin paun 400.
Koaros me sohte iang sounpei wie kolokolete dipwisou me re koledi ko.
Moses oh Eleasar eri wahla kohl ko ni Impwalo, pwe KAUN-O en kin apwahpwalih oh sinsile mehn Israel ko.
